counselPage.metaDesc: What a Satohash / OpenTimestamps stamp is — and is not — for eIDAS, ESIGN, and UETA readers.
counselPage.title: What a Satohash stamp proves
counselPage.lede: Bitcoin-anchored proof of existence at a time, not of identity, consent, or legal validity of the underlying document.
counselPage.is1: A SHA-256 fingerprint computed on the client. The file never needs to leave the device.
counselPage.is2: An OpenTimestamps receipt that calendars later commit into a Bitcoin transaction.
counselPage.is3: Independently verifiable with ots-cli or any OTS library against public calendars or your own Bitcoin node.
counselPage.is4: Compatible in spirit with ESIGN / UETA (US) and eIDAS electronic timestamp concepts — a mathematical attestation of prior existence, not a notary commission.
counselPage.not1: Proof that a particular person authored, signed, or consented to the file.
counselPage.not2: Proof the file is true, lawful, admissible, or complete.
counselPage.not3: A government-issued notarial act or qualified trust service by itself.
counselPage.not4c: Confirmed means a Bitcoin block includes the attestation.
counselPage.footer: Satohash is the product surface. The chain of trust is OpenTimestamps + Bitcoin proof of work. Counsel should verify the .ots independently.

watchPage.subtitle: File stays local. Fingerprint timestamps. Bitcoin anchors the proof. Full educational cut is primary; 10s teaser still here.
watchPage.pendingBodyAfter: means a Bitcoin block includes it. Do not treat pending as final.
watchPage.fullHookLine: Got a file that needs to exist right now — and be provable forever? Satohash stamps it onto Bitcoin. Permanently. For free.
watchPage.fullProblemLine: Emailing yourself a copy is not proof. Satohash fingerprints the file and gives you a receipt that cannot be faked.
watchPage.fullHowLine: One click. No account. No wallet. Independent calendars, then one Bitcoin block. The proof is yours forever.
watchPage.fullBatchLine: A folder of documents? Batch stamp them. Every file gets its own independent proof.
watchPage.fullVerifyLine: Come back later, enter the stamp. Calendars and Bitcoin agree — green badge. Trust, but verify.
watchPage.fullCtaLine: Nothing to install. Nothing to buy. Stamp your first file free at satohash.io.
watchPage.shortHookLine: Got a file that must exist — and be provable forever?
watchPage.shortPrivacyLine: Your file never leaves your device. Only a fingerprint is timestamped.
watchPage.shortAnchorLine: Independent calendars. One Bitcoin block. A proof no one can fake.
watchPage.shortCtaLine: Free. No account. Stamp it at satohash.io.
